description: A modal dialog with backdrop, focus trap, and ESC to close.

open().description: Opens the dialog modally in the browser top layer.

--open.description: Opens the dialog modally. Focus returns to the invoking button when it closes.

--close.description: Requests that the dialog close, with reason "command"; aihio-before-close can still cancel it.

--toggle.description: Opens the dialog when it is closed and closes it when it is open.

aihio-before-close.description: Cancelable request fired before the dialog closes.

handled: The native <dialog> panel supplies dialog semantics, and showModal() supplies modality
aria-labelledby is wired to aihio-dialog-title when present
aria-describedby is wired to aihio-dialog-description when present
Native modal dialog behavior makes the document outside the dialog inert and contains keyboard focus
A trigger and a Cancel button work from markup alone: commandfor plus command="--open" or command="--close" needs no script
Opening focuses an authored autofocus element, otherwise the first rendered tab stop — never a hidden field or an unselected tab — and Tab wraps between the first and last rendered tab stops
Focus is restored to the trigger on close
A shared overlay lock prevents concurrent dialogs from restoring page scroll too early

required.requirement: Provide aria-label on aihio-dialog describing the dialog's purpose; otherwise screen readers announce an unnamed dialog.
Label the confirming button with variant="destructive" and keep Cancel as the first focusable control.

counterExamples.reason: Missing header and footer. Provide aihio-dialog-title for a name and aihio-dialog-footer for actions.
Dialogs must not be nested. Close the current dialog before opening another.
Built-in commands such as show-modal only act on a native <dialog>, and this one is inside the component's shadow root, so nothing happens. Use command="--open".

examples:
<aihio-button commandfor="confirm-delete" command="--open" variant="destructive">Delete project</aihio-button>

<aihio-dialog id="confirm-delete">
  <aihio-dialog-header>
    <aihio-dialog-title>Are you sure?</aihio-dialog-title>
    <aihio-dialog-description>This action cannot be undone.</aihio-dialog-description>
  </aihio-dialog-header>
  <aihio-dialog-footer>
    <aihio-button commandfor="confirm-delete" command="--close" variant="outline">Cancel</aihio-button>
    <aihio-button variant="destructive">Delete</aihio-button>
  </aihio-dialog-footer>
</aihio-dialog>
